# awesome-free-ai-coding

> Legal free LLM APIs and coding agents for AI coding — free tiers, no-card trials and free models, probe-verified twice a week against live model catalogs and pricing pages. Generated 2026-10-31 from the registry; every offer above the Archived heading passed a probe in the last 60 days and has not failed 3 in a row.

Each offer links to a page with the free tier in the vendor's own words, the connection details (base URL, where to get a key, model ids, an Anthropic-format URL where the vendor documents one), the evidence the probe reads and the row's history. "No card" means the vendor asks for no payment method; "no key" means the endpoint answers without an account; "no account" means the vendor prints a key anyone may call it with. Offers the list carried and carries no more are listed last, under Archived, each with why it left.

## Coding agents & CLIs

- [GitHub Copilot Free](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/github-copilot-free/): Free Copilot plan for individual developers in VS Code, JetBrains, Visual Studio and CLI; completions, limited chat and agent usage; no card; not offered in Russia, Iran, Belarus and 2 more places; what you send may be used to train or improve models unless you turn that off
- [opencode](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/opencode/): Open-source coding agent whose opencode Zen gateway prices a rotating set of models at zero — inside OpenCode only, no sign-in; any provider via BYOK; no card; what you send may be used to train or improve models; free models: `big-pickle`, `nemotron-3-ultra`, `nemotron-3.5-lightning`, `mimo-v2.6-flash`, `deepseek-v4.1-flash`
- [Kilo Code](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/kilo-code/): Open-source coding agent with an Auto Free mode and a keyless OpenAI-compatible gateway, alongside BYOK and local models; no card; not offered in Iran, Syria, Cuba and 1 more place; what you send may be used to train or improve models; no key; OpenAI-compatible at https://api.kilo.ai/api/gateway; Codex CLI profile at https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding/blob/main/configs/codex/kilo-code.config.toml; free models: `nemotron-3-ultra`, `north-mini-code`, `laguna-s-2.1`, `laguna-xs-2.1`, `nemotron-3.5-lightning`, `dots-3-note`, `nemotron-3-nano-omni`, `nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b`, `xing4.0-29b-a4b`, `beam-1.0`
- [Kiro](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/kiro/): Perpetual free tier of AWS's spec-driven agentic IDE (successor to Amazon Q Developer) with Claude and open-weight models; no card; what you send may be used to train or improve models unless you turn that off; free models: `claude-sonnet-4.5`, `claude-sonnet-4`, `glm-5`, `minimax-m2.5`, `deepseek-v3.2`, `qwen3-coder-next`, `minimax-m2.1`
- [Google Antigravity](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/antigravity/): Google's agent-first IDE and CLI, with a $0 Individual plan serving Gemini and third-party agent models; no card; not offered in mainland China, Russia, Hong Kong and 21 more places; what you send may be used to train or improve models unless you turn that off; free models: `gemini-3.8-flash`, `claude-opus-4.6`, `claude-sonnet-4.6`, `gpt-oss-120b`
- [Freebuff](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/freebuff/): Ad-funded coding agent for CLI, desktop, web, cloud and chat, with daily regional allowances and conditional free-session access; no card; what you send may be used to train or improve models; free models: `solar-pro-4`, `solar-mini-4`, `mimo-v2.6-flash`, `glm-5.3-flash`, `deepseek-v4.1-flash`; Daily allowance — the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, the Netherlands, Austria, Luxembourg, Iceland, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Belgium, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Malta, South Korea: 30 hours per day; Other countries: 5 hours per day; VPN or proxy: 4 hours per day. Check your account's picker for current model hour prices. Solar Pro 4: shared daily hours; available in limited mode; Solar Mini 4: shared daily hours; available in limited mode; MiMo V2.6 Flash Fast: shared daily hours; available in limited mode; GLM 5.3 Flash: shared daily hours; available in limited mode; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 10/17: shared daily hours; available in limited mode; GPT-6 Luna: shared daily hours; full access only; MiMo 2.6 Pro: shared daily hours; full access only; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Fast 10/17: shared daily hours; full access only; GPT-6.1 Terra: shared daily hours; full access only; GPT-6.1 Sol: paid plan; Gemini 4 Argon: paid plan; Gemini 3.8 Flash: paid plan; Muse Spark 1.3: shared daily hours; full access only; Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite: specialist tasks only. Where the app uses session-based limited mode, the free allowance is 6 one-hour sessions per day. Your balance is measured in hours. Gemini 3.8 Flash: “PAID-ONLY row” (source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CodebuffAI/codebuff/main/common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts). GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 4 Argon: The public Free-plan comparison requires a paid plan; paid plans allow one one-hour session per day. (source: https://freebuff.com/plans). Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite handles specialist tasks such as file finding and research. Muse Spark 1.3: Credit-funded at full access; a paid plan is required at limited access. (source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CodebuffAI/codebuff/main/common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts). GPT-6.1 Terra: “Open on full access, a paid plan on limited access. One session a day on every plan.” (source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CodebuffAI/codebuff/main/common/src/constants/freebuff-sol-promo.ts). MiMo V2.6 Flash Fast is the default on CLI, Desktop, Web, and Cloud. Daily hours refill at midnight in your local timezone and unused daily hours do not carry over. Older app versions show the same balance as Freebucks, five to an hour. (source: https://freebuff.com/llms.txt).

- [Codex (ChatGPT Free)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/openai-codex-cli/): Codex desktop access on a $0 ChatGPT Free plan, subject to rollout; no card; not offered in mainland China, Russia, Hong Kong and 24 more places; free models: `gpt-6-luna`

- [CodeBuddy (Tencent)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/codebuddy/): Tencent's VS Code / JetBrains / CLI coding agent whose Free plan carries 100 credits a month, a daily activity bonus of 30 and 250 welcome credits, with every model open while the promotion runs — its site and the agent's own endpoint unreachable from the US, India and Russia; no card; not offered in the United States, India and Russia

## Free models by name

A model gets a page of its own once two rows or more serve it free, or it measures notable, strong or frontier, or it has a dated free promotion: every row that serves it, the limits in the vendor's words and the ids to call. Every other model is named on the one row above that serves it.

## Archived

- [AI21 Labs (Jamba)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/ai21-labs/): no longer listed — vendor-announced shutdown on 2026-08-09
- [Aider](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/aider/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-07-19: BYOK only — the tool is free and open source but bundles no model access of its own, and its docs send readers to other vendors' free tiers, which this list carries directly
- [Amazon Q Developer](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/amazon-q-developer/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-10-26: closed to new Free accounts and new subscriptions; existing IDE users retain access until the announced end of support
- [Blue Claw Network](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/blue-claw/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-10-15: Current onboarding requires purchasing prepaid credits before API use; the previous $5 welcome grant is no longer advertised (https://blueclaw.network/quickstart).
- [Cerebras Inference](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/cerebras-free/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-09-16: its only free offer was $5 of credit granted after a verified payment method is added, expiring in 30 days — a one-off credit behind a card, which CONTRIBUTING does not admit
- [Crush + Charm Hyper](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/charm-hyper/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-10-15: The current FAQ retires the monthly free Hypercredit allowance; access requires a paid plan or prepaid credits from $5 (https://hyper.charm.land/faq).
- [DeepSeek Platform](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/deepseek/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-07-27: the 5M-token signup grant was only ever reported by third parties, and DeepSeek's own pricing page prices every model and names no free grant
- [Easy GonkaAI API](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/easy-gonka-api/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-07-19: rejected for cause — its /for-agents page carried a prompt injection aimed at AI agents (auto-signup, credential exfiltration, referral spam)
- [GitHub Models](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/github-models/): no longer listed — vendor-announced shutdown on 2026-07-30
- [Hugging Face Inference Providers](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/huggingface-inference/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-10-08: free accounts no longer receive inference credits — the current billing table lists None and requires purchasing credits or a paid subscription
- [Infomaniak AI Services](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/infomaniak-ai/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-09-16: a one-month wallet of a million credits, and "A credit card is required to start using the API" — a one-off credit behind a card, which CONTRIBUTING does not admit
- [Kenari](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/kenari/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-09-16: rejected for cause — the operator's own JavaScript bundle showed its capacity coming from pooled ChatGPT and Codex OAuth credentials, captcha solvers and a proxy pool that multiplies per-IP free quotas
- [LongCat API Platform](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/longcat/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-08-14: the daily free quota was gone before the row was listed — the change log retired the Flash line on 2026-05-29 and switched billing on for LongCat-2.0 on 2026-06-30, and no LongCat page still published the 100K tokens a day
- [MiMo Code](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/mimo-code/): no longer listed — vendor-announced shutdown on 2026-07-26
- [Poolside Platform](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/poolside/): no longer listed — vendor-announced shutdown on 2026-10-31
- [Puter.js (free LLM API)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/puter-free/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-07-19: a browser SDK billed to each end user's Puter account, with no HTTP endpoint a coding agent could call; the OpenAI-compatible endpoint read on 2026-09-14 needs a paid plan
- [Reka AI](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/reka/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-08-11: the $10 of free credits a month rested on one dated announcement post; no live Reka page corroborated a recurring grant, and the platform sells pay-as-you-go credits
- [SambaNova Cloud](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/sambanova-cloud/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-09-23: new accounts get no free usage — the console's Free plan has read "Add a payment method and purchase credits to run your first requests" since 2026-08, where until 2026-06-20 it read "free API credits. No credit card required"; only the docs still describe a free tier
- [Scaleway Generative APIs](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/scaleway-generative/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-09-16: 1,000,000 free tokens once per customer, and "Ordering Scaleway resources requires a valid credit card" — a one-off credit behind a card, which CONTRIBUTING does not admit
- [uncloseai (unturf)](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/uncloseai/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-10-22: public beta closed; the endpoint requires a key and key registration is closed
- [Yolo-Auto](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/yolo-auto/): no longer listed — delisted on 2026-10-15: free accounts now include 0 requests/week and API inference requires a paid plan

## Machine-readable

- [index.json](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/index.json): every row with its connection details and probe, plus the watchlist of services considered and not listed
- [feed.xml](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/feed.xml): Atom feed of every change — rows arriving, leaving and changing their free models
- [Provider pages](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/providers/): one page per row, live and archived
- [Model pages](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/models/): every free model on the list and the rows that serve it, and a page of its own for each model once two rows or more serve it free, or it measures notable, strong or frontier, or it has a dated free promotion
- [Filterable table](https://mvalentsev.github.io/awesome-free-ai-coding/browse.html): the same rows filtered by category, card, key and API format
- [configs/opencode.json](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding/blob/main/configs/opencode.json): opencode config with every OpenAI-compatible row wired up
- [configs/claude-code.sh](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding/blob/main/configs/claude-code.sh): one shell function per gateway that serves the Anthropic Messages format, for Claude Code
- [configs/litellm.yaml](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding/blob/main/configs/litellm.yaml): LiteLLM proxy config over the same rows, with one-name fallback groups (free/nokey)
- [configs/codex/litellm.config.toml](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding/blob/main/configs/codex/litellm.config.toml): Codex CLI profile over litellm.yaml — Codex speaks only the Responses API, which the proxy answers from each lane's chat completions
- [README](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding): the list itself, with the picks table and how it stays fresh
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/mvalentsev/awesome-free-ai-coding/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): what qualifies, how rows are ranked, how the probes work
